c.tagline: Mountain-ringed capital where downtown meets world-class skiing and canyons.

taxi.fareNote: Traditional taxis are metered, but ride-hailing (Uber/Lyft) is far more common and usually cheaper; street-hailing is rare outside downtown.

emergency.note: 911 is the single nationwide emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance across the US.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

hood_landmark.Sugar House: Sugar House Park Salt Lake City
hood_landmark.The Avenues: The Avenues Salt Lake City historic homes

avoid.reason: The Pioneer Park / Rio Grande blocks and stretches of North Temple feel sketchy after dark due to concentrated homelessness and drug activity.

hood_desc: The walkable core around Temple Square, City Creek Center, and the Delta Center; home to the main TRAX lines, the Free Fare Zone, and most big hotels, making it the easiest base for first-timers.
A historic hillside grid of Victorian homes, leafy streets, and small cafes just northeast of downtown; quiet, residential, and popular with locals and university students.
A compact, artsy district of independent boutiques, coffee shops, a beloved indie cinema, and casual restaurants; the city's most walkable hipster pocket.
A laid-back, family-friendly neighborhood built around Sugar House Park and Westminster University, with local breweries, shops, and a relaxed pace away from downtown.
A fast-changing former industrial area just south of downtown filled with craft breweries, distilleries, art studios, and new restaurants; the heart of SLC's maker scene.

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink.

transit.hours: TRAX and buses run roughly 5am to midnight; FrontRunner runs early morning to about 11pm on weekdays with limited Saturday service and no Sunday service.
transit.pay: Tap a contactless bank card or phone, or a FAREPAY card, at TRAX and FrontRunner platforms and on buses. A single UTA bus or TRAX fare is $2.50; FrontRunner is distance-based. Downtown's Free Fare Zone lets you ride TRAX free between North Temple and 900 South.

train: Salt Lake Central Station (FrontRunner / Amtrak California Zephyr)

transit.m: TRAX Green Line to downtown (~20 min)

tip.r: ~15-20% at restaurants and bars is expected across the US; tipping is a core part of service workers' pay.
